card.name: Start of a number range before "to"
card.fires_on: The first number (often a single digit like 1 or 7) in a range, right before the word "to" or a dash, such as doses, durations and ranges.

modes.label: Dose or duration range
modes.description: The opening number of a dose or time range that is about to be followed by "to" and a second number.
modes.example: in the dose range of <<1>> mg/kg to 8 mg/kg.

modes.label: Digit inside a longer number
modes.description: A digit in a multi-digit or decimal number that is the start of a range.

modes.label: Dash range
modes.description: The first number in a hyphenated range such as a series of years or volumes.

card.writes: It promotes "to" words (zu, 至, till), so it adds the word that links the first number to the upper limit of a range.
card.plain: It spots the first number of a range like "1 to 2 mg" and prepares the word "to" to come next.
